name: copilot-vscode-host
description: Copilot Chat and VS Code agent host boundary: instructions mirror Claude/Codex agents and call oflow JSON; no vendor-specific GitLab API surface.
boundaries: Host never stores GITLAB_TOKEN in repo files.
All remote writes go through plan approve apply verify.
Copilot/VS Code runs the same oflow CLI JSON contract; the editor stores no additional GitLab credentials.
Workspace settings and .github/copilot-instructions.md may point at oflow commands but never embed tokens.
